comments.body:
Part of the Records of Study of Numbers Memorial Album, this Sailor Equip is created using Sophia points obtained from Legacy theme discoveries. Requires Transmutation Alchemy Equipment or Complex Alchemy Equipment furniture. Recipe:

Base item: Oak Plating
Handicrafts/Alchemy R11
Sophia points consumed per production: 1400

Ingredients:
Element of Wisdom x3
Experiment File x5
Terra Extract x10
20% chance of success

As with all Transmutation Alchemy recipes, Book of Uroboros items work fine. Sadly, Book of the Wingless Dragon do not.
